name: @hireme/designer-app
description: HireMe designer workspace and local Creator Worker

scripts.dev: npm run config && concurrently -k -s first -n renderer,electron "npm run renderer:dev -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env HIREME_DEV_PROFILE=1 HIREME_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.check: npm run config && node --check electron/main.mjs && node --check electron/auth.mjs && node --check electron/data.mjs && node --check electron/aiProviders.mjs && node --check electron/agentAuthoring.mjs && node --check electron/creatorWorker.mjs && node --check electron/creatorWorkerExecutor.mjs && node --check electron/designProjects.mjs && node --check electron/managementIpcError.mjs && node --check electron/runIpcError.mjs && node --check electron/rendererTrust.mjs && node --check electron/runLifecycle.mjs && node --check electron/preload.cjs
scripts.build: npm run renderer:build && npm run check
scripts.package: npm run config:required && npm run renderer:build && electron-builder --dir
scripts.dist: npm run config:required && npm run renderer:build && electron-builder
